items.title: 34:26 · Poisoned arrows and shallow coastal waters killed
items.detail: Poisoned arrows and shallow coastal waters killed European raiding parties and raised the direct coercive cost of coastal kidnapping.

items.title: 34:34 · Between 1445 and 1446 Portuguese operations shifted
items.detail: Between 1445 and 1446, Portuguese operations shifted from direct amphibious raiding to a modular commercial protocol: supplying European horses, textiles, and weapons to coastal intermediaries in exchange for captives taken in interior conflicts.

items.title: 34:47 · With the fiscal pipeline operating and the
items.detail: With the fiscal pipeline operating and the royal fifth flowing into Lisbon, the Crown required supranational legal title and an ideological narrative capable of neutralizing Christian moral objections to enslaving fellow human beings.

items.title: 35:00 · The legal apparatus arrived through papal diplomacy
items.detail: The legal apparatus arrived through papal diplomacy.

items.title: 35:10 · Dum Diversas granted the Portuguese Crown explicit
items.detail: Dum Diversas granted the Portuguese Crown explicit ecclesiastical authority to attack, conquer, and reduce Saracens, pagans, and other non-Christians to perpetual servitude while confiscating their kingdoms and goods.
